initialPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a single transparent hand-painted dog-bed sprite for the warm illustrated room in reference 2.
Input images: Image 1 is the SHAPE AND SOFT MATERIAL reference for the fluffy donut dog bed only. Image 2 is STYLE AND PERSPECTIVE reference only for a detailed softly painted 2.5D room.
Primary request: turn the round fluffy dog bed from the first reference into a beautiful refined hand-painted cream and pale camel donut pet bed. This is an EMPTY bed for a small white Maltese to sleep in later. Preserve the cozy thick raised circular bolster and clearly visible recessed soft inner cushion. Remove every part of the mustard yellow chair or wall behind the reference bed.
Shape and composition: perspective ellipse seen from a low three-quarter frontal view, mildly above, matching a pet bed sitting on the floor at the front-right corner of the reference room. Bed is about 1.83 times as wide as its total visible height. The back bolster is visible behind the open center, side bolsters curve forward, and the FRONT bolster is LOW enough that a small sleeping dog added later could be seen naturally inside. The interior cushion is a generous clearly visible broad soft oval, centered at 50% width and about 49% total image height. Entire bed and its lower edge are visible, with about 3–5% transparent padding, filling nearly the whole canvas. No dramatic top-down view.
Materials and style: soft warm ivory cream shaggy plush, subtle pale camel shading in the creases, small hand-painted tufts and delicately irregular fuzzy silhouette; tactile illustrated brushwork matching the existing room, NOT a photographic furry product cutout or a cartoon icon. Restrained painted details that remain readable at 260×142 pixels.
Lighting: gentle neutral daylight from upper-left and warm reflected room light. A very soft thin transparent contact shadow directly beneath the bed, with real alpha fading to zero, no hard floor.
Constraints: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no white rectangle. No dog or other animal. No person, chair, yellow curved shell, wall, floor plane, furniture, bowl, blanket, paw print, logo, writing, watermark, label, or objects inside the bed. Never crop the bed or fluffy edges. The bed should be creamy neutral rather than canary yellow.
